name: National Talent Scholarship Undergraduate
description: Scholarship assistance for eligible undergraduate students pursuing Agriculture or allied disciplines.
details: The National Talent Scholarship (NTS) is implemented by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) under the scheme Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India. The scholarship is awarded to students pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture and allied disciplines who have secured admission through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) and are studying in an ICAR-funded Agricultural University located outside their State of domicile. The scholarship aims to support meritorious students by providing financial assistance during their undergraduate studies. The scholarship is initially awarded for one year from the date of admission and is renewable for the remaining duration of the degree programme, subject to satisfactory academic performance and conduct.
eligibility: Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or allied disciplines
Admission through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) conducted for ICAR admissions
Enrolled in an Agricultural University located outside the student's State of domicile
Studying in an Agricultural University funded under the ICAR scheme Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India
Must maintain merit and good conduct
Must attend classes regularly
Must pursue studies on a full-time basis
Must not undertake part-time or full-time employment
Must not receive another scholarship or financial assistance during the course
Must secure minimum OGPA/CGPA of 7.00 out of 10.00 at the end of the first year, or 6.50 out of 10.00 for SC/ST students
exclusions: Students receiving another scholarship or financial assistance
Students leaving the course within one month of admission
Students changing their discipline/subject
Students changing their university during the scholarship tenure
Students undertaking part-time or full-time employment
benefits: ₹3,000 per month during the Bachelor's degree programme
Scholarship initially awarded for one year and renewable subject to prescribed conditions
required_documents: Recent passport-size photograph
Signature
Thumb impression
Admission proof through AIEE
Aadhaar number
Aadhaar-linked bank account details
Any other documents prescribed by ICAR or the concerned University
application_process: Online application through the National Scholarships Portal. Students complete registration and e-KYC, generate an OTR number, log in to the NSP, complete the application form and upload documents. Applications are verified by the institution and subsequently by the concerned State Higher Education Department or nominated State Nodal Agency.

name: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students - AICTE
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Post Graduate Scholarship of ₹12,400 per month for eligible full-time students with valid GATE/CEED scores admitted to AICTE-approved postgraduate programs in AICTE-approved institutions or university departments.
details: The scheme Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students - AICTE has been started by the All India Council for Technical Education, Government of India. AICTE awards a Post Graduate Scholarship of ₹12,400 per month to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE-approved postgraduate programs in AICTE-approved institutions or university departments as per AICTE-approved intake.
eligibility: Having a valid GATE/CEED score at the time of admission
Must be admitted as a full-time scholar
Final-year students of dual-degree integrated programmes may receive the scholarship from the 9th semester for one year
Admitted to AICTE-approved institutions or university departments
Admitted to AICTE-approved postgraduate programs
Number of scholarships is limited to the AICTE-approved intake
exclusions: Foreign students
Sponsored candidates
Candidates admitted through management quota
Students receiving financial assistance from another organization during the relevant period
Students taking second-time admission after re-qualifying GATE/CEED who have already availed the scholarship from AICTE or another centrally funded institution
benefits: ₹12,400 per month per student
Scholarship is tenable for 24 months or the duration of the course, whichever is lower
Casual leave of up to 15 days in an academic year
Medical leave of up to one month in an academic year
Maternity/paternity leave as per Government of India norms
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Passport-size photograph
Proof of age
Mark Sheets/Grade Cards and Degrees
GATE/CEED scorecard
Caste certificate, if applicable
Disability certificate, if applicable
Income certificate, if applicable
Bank account details
Any other required document
application_process: Eligible institutions upload eligible postgraduate student details on the AICTE portal and provide the student with a Unique ID. Students use the Unique ID to log in to the PG Scholarship portal and upload scanned copies of required documents. The institution verifies the student's data and approves the candidature for scholarship disbursement.

name: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Above Grade 8) - Tamil Nadu
ministry: Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Financial assistance for differently abled students studying in government-recognized schools, colleges or training centers.
details: The Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu, offers the Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Above Grade 8) program. The initiative provides financial assistance to differently abled students enrolled in government-recognized schools, colleges or training centers to help with educational expenses.
eligibility: Must be a student
Must be a differently abled person
Must be studying in 9th to 12th Standard, Degree, Postgraduate, Medical, Engineering, Vocational or other Professional Courses
Must be studying in a government-recognized school, college or training center
Must have obtained not less than 40% marks in the previous qualifying examination
benefits: ₹4,000 per annum for students studying from 9th to 12th Standard
₹6,000 per annum for Degree Courses
₹7,000 per annum for Postgraduate, Medical, Engineering, Vocational and other Professional Courses
required_documents: Certificate from the Head of the Institution
National Identity Card of the Differently Abled
Statement of Marks from the previous qualifying examination
application_process: Offline application. The applicant visits the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer during office hours and obtains the prescribed application form. The applicant fills the form, attaches the required documents and submits the signed application to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. The applicant should request a receipt or acknowledgment containing the submission date and other identification details.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families pursuing higher studies.
details: The PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students provides financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Scholarships are awarded based on the results of the Higher Secondary/Class 12 Board Examination. A maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum are provided for pursuing Graduate/Postgraduate degrees in colleges and universities and professional courses such as Medical and Engineering.
target_beneficiaries: Students pursuing higher education in recognized institutions
eligibility: Must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the respective Board of Examination in Class 12
Must be pursuing a regular degree course
Course must be at a recognized college or institution
Gross parental/family income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum
For renewal, must obtain at least 50% marks in the Annual Examination
For renewal, attendance must be at least 75%
Must have an Aadhaar-seeded bank account opened in the student's name
exclusions: Students pursuing correspondence or distance-mode courses
Students pursuing Diploma courses
Students already receiving another scholarship scheme
Students receiving State-run scholarship schemes, fee waivers or reimbursement schemes
benefits: Financial assistance to support day-to-day expenses during higher studies
Maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum
required_documents: 12th Mark Sheet
Family Income Certificate
Category/Caste Certificate for reserved category students
Disability Certificate, if applicable
Previous Year Mark Sheet for renewal applications
application_process: Online application through the National Scholarships Portal. Students complete One Time Registration, Aadhaar e-KYC and face authentication, log in through OTR, complete the application form and upload required documents. Applications are verified by the institution and subsequently by the concerned State Higher Education Department or nominated State Nodal Agency. Payment status can be tracked through the PFMS portal.
grievance_process: Grievances or complaints may be registered through the CPGRAMS grievance mechanism or with the Nodal Officer whose email is available on the NSP portal.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
ministry: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
description: Scholarship scheme for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to reduce dropout after Class VIII and encourage continuation of education at the secondary stage.
details: The National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme is a Central Sector Scheme launched in 2008 by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India. The scheme aims to award scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to arrest dropout at Class VIII and encourage continuation of education at the secondary stage. Up to 1,00,000 scholarships are awarded to eligible students whose parental income is not more than ₹3,50,000 per annum from all sources at the time of selection.
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections
Students studying in Government, Government-aided or local body schools
eligibility: Parental income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum
Must have a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class VII examination for appearing in the selection test
SC/ST students receive a 5% relaxation in the Class VII marks requirement
Must be studying as a regular student in a Government, Government-aided or local body school
Must pass the State/UT selection tests
Must pass both MAT and SAT with at least 40% marks in aggregate
SC/ST students have a 32% cut-off in the selection tests
At selection, must have at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class VIII examination, with 5% relaxation for SC/ST students
For renewal, must obtain at least 60% marks in Class X, with 5% relaxation for SC/ST students
For continuation in Class X and XII, must obtain clear promotion in the first attempt
exclusions: Students studying in Kendriya Vidyalayas
Students studying in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas
Students studying in residential schools run by Central or State Government institutions where boarding, lodging and education are provided
Students studying in private schools
Students studying abroad
Students pursuing diploma/certificate-level courses
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum
₹1,000 per month
Scholarship begins at Class IX and can continue up to Class XII
Maximum scholarship duration of four years
Disbursement directly into student bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
Educational certificates/marksheets
Caste Certificate
Parent's Income Certificate
Disability Certificate, if applicable
Domicile Certificate
Any other supporting documents as required
application_process: Online application through the National Scholarships Portal. Students register, receive an Application ID and password, log in, complete the application form and upload documents. Each State/UT conducts its own selection test at the Class VIII stage using Mental Ability Test (MAT) and Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT). Payment status can be tracked through the PFMS portal.

name: "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
ministry: Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare Department, Puducherry
description: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced to extend financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially.
details: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme" is introduced to extend financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially.
eligibility: The applicant should be the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
The missing fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.
The missing fisherman must have lost his/her life while fishing.
The missing fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years.
The missing fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.
The missing fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.
benefits: ₹ 1,00,000, in two installments of ₹ 50,000 each, as immediate relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
Disbursal**
Initially, 50% will be extended within 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the family (legal heir).

The family (legal heir) should approach this department for the release of the balance 50% of the relief which will be deposited in the bank in a joint account in the name of kin (legal heir) and the competent authority concerned.

If no further information is received about the missing person, the balance amount will be released in favour of the next of kin (legal heir), after the prescribed period of 9 months from the date of release of 1st part of lump sum.
In case of the return of the missing fishermen, the amount extended as compensation either ₹ 50,000 or ₹ 1,00,000 as the case may be, will be recovered by invoking an insurance bond.***
required_documents: Photograph of the Family (Legal Heir) of the Missing Fisherman.
Residential Certificate of the Missing Fishermen.
Proof of Age of the Missing Fishermen.
Declaration That the Missing Fisherman Was Not a Beneficiary of the Old Age Pension Scheme.
Membership Certificate from the President/Administrator of Fishermen/Fisherwoman Co-operative Society.
Electoral Identity Card (Attested Copy)
Ration Card (Attested Copy)
Panchayathar’s Letter of Village Concerned
Name, Relationship, and Address of the Legal Heir (Affidavit in ₹ 5 Stamp Paper, Affixing as the Legal Heir Duly Signed in Before a Notary Public).
‘No Claim’ Certificate in Respect of Financial Assistance Extended by the Revenue Department Should Be Obtained From the Department of Revenue and Disaster Management.
FIR and Non-traceable Certificate From Respective Station House Officer of Police Department.
Statement of Next Kin of Missing Person, Statement of Panchayathars, Statement of Persons Who Have Lastly Seen the Missing Person.
Advertisement/newspaper Report of the Missing Person in Gazette in Tamil/local Newspaper, Municipality/ Commune Panchayat Office, Ration Shop, and Police Station in the Vernacular Language.
application_process:
[Offline]
Step 1: The interested applicant should visit the office of the concerned authority i.e. the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare/Sub-Offices of outlying regions in all four regions.
Step 1: The interested applicant should request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority.
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
*The affected family (legal heir) should apply immediately within 30 days from the date of the event for consideration.

name: AICTE SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME-SFURTI SCHEME
description: Short Term Training Programme-SFURTI Program aims to provide financial assistance from AICTE to the institutions for conducting faculty and student trainings to enable faculty members and students in the field of technical education.
details: Short Term Training Programme-SFURTI Program aims to provide financial assistance from AICTE to the institutions for conducting faculty and student trainings to enable faculty members and students in the field of technical education.
eligibility: The institution should be AICTE approved.
benefits: Financial Assistance**: Limit of funding ₹ 4,00,000/- to the institution.
Disbursement of the Fund:**
The full amount of the grant sanctioned shall be released after successful conduct of the program to Indian Micro Enterprises Development Foundation (IMEDF).

The amount spent by the institute on the conduct of STTP-SFURTI shall be adjusted on the basis of utilization certificate and detailed expenditure statement submitted by the IMEDF on the prescribed format along with other mandatory documents viz feedback form, copy of proceedings and completion report etc
required_documents: Feedback Form
Copy of Proceedings
Completion Report

[Online]
Registration of New Institute:
Step 01: Visit http://portal.aicte-india.org/partnerportal_enu/start.swe and click on 'New Institute' button.
Step 02: Users will be redirected to another website. Hover the cursor on Login and select ‘Investor Login’.
Step 03: New users need to click on ‘Sign Up Now’ to register.

Step 05: After successful verification Click on ‘Sign Up Now’ to register.

name: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
description: Launched in 2014, the "Funeral and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme for Unregistered Laborers" is a welfare scheme by the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Madhya Pradesh, providing funeral assistance and ex-gratia payments in case of death or permanent disability.
details: Launched in 2014, the "Funeral and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme for Unregistered Laborers" is a welfare scheme by the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Madhya Pradesh, providing funeral assistance and ex-gratia payments in case of death or permanent disability.
eligibility: The deceased construction worker should have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB).
The deceased construction worker should have held an active regular membership.
The only person who is a legal heir/dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply under the scheme.
The deceased worker should have valid identity card.
benefits: **Funeral Assistance:** ₹3,000 payable in case of death of a construction laborer.1. **Grace Amount:**
Death due to an accident during construction work: ₹4,00,000/-.
Permanent disability due to an accident during construction work: ₹2,00,000/-.

Passport-size photograph
Proof of residence
Ration Card
Bank account details
Death certificate of worker
Regular registration certificate of the worker
Nominee/legal heir certificate
F.I.R. And a copy of Panchnama.
Post-mortem report in the state of death.
Disability certificate obtained from District Medical Board in case of permanent disability.

[Offline]
Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat and Commissioner/Chief Municipal Officer Municipal Body and request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority.
Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents, within the prescribed period (if any), to the authority.
Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
﻿
NOTE 1: Ensure that the application is submitted within the prescribed period, if any.
NOTE 2: The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of the accident or death.
Designated Officer for Approval -
For rural areas - Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat
For urban areas - Commissioner/Chief Municipal Officer, Municipal Corporation

Step2: On the homepage, find and click on Planning Application, then register the applications of registered workers for the benefits of schemes.

Step 4: Choose the scheme you wish to apply for in order to avail the benefits.
Step 5: Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents as prompted.
Step 6: Finally, click on Submit Application to complete the process.

details: The scheme aims to facilitate Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) in marketing their products and services through individual or collective participation in tenders via consortia. It helps MSEs secure bulk orders, improve competitiveness, and access government procurement opportunities.

name: Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department
description: The scheme "Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University" provides a monthly fellowship to meritorious Post-Graduate students across various faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.
details: The scheme "Fellowship for the Post-Graduate Students in Various Faculties Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University" provides a monthly fellowship to meritorious Post-Graduate students across various faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.
eligibility: The applicant must be a student.
The applicant must be enrolled in a Master’s or Ph.D. program at Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University (SDAU).
The applicant must have secured a first-class or its equivalent OGPA in the qualifying undergraduate or postgraduate examination from a State Agricultural University in Gujarat.
The applicant must be 28 years of age or below at the time of application.
The applicant must maintain a minimum OGPA of 7.5 and must not receive an “F” (Fail) or “I” (Incomplete) grade during the course of study.
benefits: Master’s degree students:** ₹5,000/- per month for 2 years.  - **Ph.D. degree students:** ₹5,000/- per month for 3 years.
> **Note:** The University shall annually award four fellowships in each of the concerned faculties for both Master&#39;s well as Doctorate degree programmes.
required_documents: Graduate Mark Sheet
Post Graduate Mark sheet
Passport Size Photos
Bank Account Details (should be linked with Aadhaar Number).
application_process:
[Offline]
Step 1: Obtain the prescribed application form from the University.
Step 2:  Submit the completed application to the Registrar by 31st December of the same year.
Step 3: Selection will be made by a university committee based on merit and eligibility.
Note: Fellowship notification is released by 30th November every year.

name: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
description: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.
details: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.
eligibility: The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University.
The applicant’s annual family income should be less than ₹1,00,000.
The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the university’s merit guidelines.
The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline.
benefits: Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver.
Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence.
The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing.
Granted once every academic year, at the beginning of the session.
Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor.
Validity:
Boys: Up to 3 academic years
Girls: Up to 4 academic years
required_documents: Duly Filled Prescribed Application Form
Valid Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.)
Income Certificate (Issued by a Competent Government Authority)
Latest Academic Mark Sheets
Admission Confirmation Letter
Bank Account Details (Passbook Copy or Cancelled Cheque)
application_process:
[Offline]
Step 1: Applications are invited on a prescribed form from eligible and meritorious students.
Step  2: Based on the applications, the Dean Student Welfare prepares a list following the prescribed procedure.
Step  3: The list is forwarded to the Registrar and Vice Chancellor for approval.
Step 4: Once approved, the final list of selected students is issued by an office order.
Step 5: Approved students receive the tuition fee exemption accordingly

name: Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expense
description: The "Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses" aims to provide financial assistance for funeral expenses of a deceased Brahmin in their family, where the family has no other means to meet the same. This scheme covers Andhra Pradesh all 13 districts, to meet the funeral expenses of the deceased Brahmi.
details: The "Garuda Scheme for Funeral Expenses" aims to provide financial assistance for funeral expenses of a deceased Brahmin in their family, where the family has no other means to meet the same. This scheme covers Andhra Pradesh all 13 districts, to meet the funeral expenses of the deceased Brahmi.
eligibility: The applicant should be a close relative of the deceased (Spouse/Son/Daughter/Parent/Brother/Grandson).
The applicant should provide a self-declaration that he/she is the legal heir of the deceased.
The applicant should belong to the Brahmin community and reside in Andhra Pradesh.
The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹75,000/-.
The applicant should not have availed himself/ herself of any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose.
benefits: Financial Assistance of ₹10,000/- for funeral expenses.
required_documents: Passport-size Photograph of the Applicant
Aadhar Card of the Applicant
Aadhar Card of the Deceased
White Ration Card/Income Certificate (issued by Mee Seva/Revenue Department)
Caste Certificate (issued from Mee Seva)
Residence Certificate (issued from Mee Seva)

The received claim will be investigated by the Secretary of the Market Committee, and the inquiry must be completed within one week. The final report shall be submitted to the Chairman/Administrator of the Mandi Committee in the prescribed format attached to the claim form. In areas where the Mandi Committee does not have an office, the concerned Tehsildar will conduct the inquiry and forward it to the respective Mandi Committee.

All the above proceedings should be completed within two months, and in special circumstances, the Chairman/Administrator of the Mandi Committee may extend the time period as required.
For the payment of assistance claims, the Mandi Board will prepare a bank draft of the sanctioned amount in the name of the claimant and send it to the Secretary of the concerned Mandi Committee for disbursement.

ministry: Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare Department, Puducherry
description: The scheme "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the sudden demise of the breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.
details: The scheme "Immediate Death Relief Assistance" is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the sudden demise of the breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family.
eligibility: The applicant should be the family (legal heir) of the deceased fisherman.
The deceased fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry.

The deceased fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years.
The deceased fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.
The deceased fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.
benefits: ₹ 1,00,000 as immediate death relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the deceased fisherman, received within 15 days to 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the affected family.

description: Through this scheme, 30% Subsidy subject to a max. of ₹1,00,00,000/- will be granted on the investment made on building with a minimum extent of 50,000 sq.ft. constructed area, by the infrastructure developers/industries for leasing out to Information Technology industries or for own industrial use.
details: Through this scheme, 30% Subsidy subject to a max. of ₹1,00,00,000/- will be granted on the investment made on building with a minimum extent of 50,000 sq.ft. constructed area, by the infrastructure developers/industries for leasing out to Information Technology industries or for own industrial use.
eligibility: The investment should have been made on building with a minimum extent of 50,000 sq.ft. constructed area.
The investment should have been made by the infrastructure developers/industries.
The investment should have been made for leasing out to IT industries or for own industrial use (for manufacturer of computer systems, Software/ITES, BPO, KPO).

The unit should provide at least 60% of employment to the people of the Union territory of Puducherry of the total employment strength of the industrial units. This 60% of the local employment will have to be maintained by the industrial unit during the period specified in the Affidavit.

The industrial unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset including plant and machinery in any manner till the completion of 5 years from the date of submitting the application/disbursement of the subsidy whichever is later.
The additional investments made by the new/existing industrial units after availing the first claim are also eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.
The date of commencement as admitted by the entrepreneurs shall be reckoned after due verification by the officials of the Industries Department.
The units which have commenced commercial production on or after 1-4-2017 are considered new industries.
The units which have commenced production before 1-4-2017 are considered as existing units.
Special Cases**

If, two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same person as proprietor, common partners, common Board of Directors/shareholders, such units are eligible for subsidy as separate entity provided the location of the unit are different and licenses /clearances/ registrations are obtained separately for the enterprises.
benefits: 30% subsidy, subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,00,000/-.
_*The building value will be assessed by the PIPDIC/Public Works Department._
Number of Installments**
The infrastructure subsidy shall be disbursed in annual installment not exceeding ₹25,00,000/- per annum till completion of the total eligible subsidy.
Mode of Disbursement**

The subsidy amount shall be disbursed through the financial institutions/banks only, if the unit is financed by them, towards the adjustment against the loan availed by the entrepreneurs or for the creation of additional fixed assets or for the working capital purposes.
In case of self-financed units, the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the entrepreneur/unit.
The financial institution shall mean and include PIPDIC or any other Government Corporation, Scheduled Banks including Co-operative Banks.

description: The objective of this scheme is to increase the inland fish production, and to enhance the income of farmers in the State though aquaculture. Input assistance is provided to the farmers who have excavated farm ponds under MGNREGA for facilitating the production of fingerling and fish.
details: The objective of this scheme is to increase the inland fish production, and to enhance the income of farmers in the State though aquaculture. Input assistance is provided to the farmers who have excavated farm ponds under MGNREGA for facilitating the production of fingerling and fish.
eligibility: The applicant should be a resident of Odisha.
The applicant must have a bank account in his/her name in Odisha.
The farm pond should have been excavated by the applicant.
The farm pond should have been excavated under the various Government schemes including Watershed Development Projects & MGNREGA through the Directorate of Soil Conservation & Watershed Development.
The farm pond should have a minimum 5 feet water depth.
The farm pond should have sufficient water retaining capacity for a minimum 5 months of culture period.

Primary Level Organizations: Maximum ₹15.00 lakh (Central Government share).

Amount to be used towards activities that attract consumers to gear up overall sales of handloom goods.
Enable handloom agencies to adjust prices towards increasing cost competitiveness, improve designs, and invest in infrastructure.

details: The scheme aims to ensure long-term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and to incentivize manufacturers to move from Crush, Tear, Curl tea to Orthodox tea production. The scheme is implemented by the Finance Department and the Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Assam.
eligibility: General Eligibility**
The applicant must be a tea plantation across all sizes
The applicant must be a tea manufacturing unit manufacturing Crush, Tear, Curl Tea, Orthodox Tea, or Speciality tea including Green tea, Oolong Tea, White tea, Yellow tea and Purple tea
The applicant must be located entirely in Assam
The applicant must not have any part of the plantation or manufacturing facility located outside the State of Assam

The applicant must be manufacturing Orthodox tea, Green tea, White tea, Oolong tea, Singhpo tea, Purple Tea, Yellow tea or other Speciality tea (not manufactured through Crush, Tear, Curl process).
The applicant must have started production on or after 1st of April, 2020.

Special Rate:** ₹12/- per kilogram for applications of Financial Year 2023-24 only (tea production year 2022-23).
Validity Period:** Extended from Financial Year 2023-24 to 2027-28.
Disbursement Mode:** Direct Benefit Transfer as reimbursement.
Claim Deadline:** Latest by 30th June on completion of every financial year.
Additional Benefit:** Provided in addition to any other subsidy claimed from the Tea Board of India or any other agency.
required_documents: Monthly E-Returns of Tea Production submitted to Tea Board India.
Tea Production Certificate.
Tea Manufacturing License.
Orthodox/Speciality Tea Production Evidence.
